document.title: Instructions for Form PENS.C/1 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service

chunks.heading: Purpose of form PENS.C/1
chunks.text: Restoration under article 24 allows a participant who re-enters the Fund to add their prior contributory service to their current participation. Form PENS.C/1 notifies the Fund of the participant's interest in restoring their most recent period of prior contributory service.

chunks.heading: Deadline to submit an expression of interest to restore
chunks.text: The expression of interest to restore prior contributory service must be submitted within one year of the date of re-entry into the Fund, or prior to separation if separation occurs earlier. Failure to observe this time limit results in permanent forfeiture of the right to restore.

chunks.heading: Which period of service is eligible for restoration
chunks.text: Only the most recent period of prior contributory service is open for restoration.

chunks.heading: When form PENS.C/1 may be used
chunks.text: The form may be used if the participant elected and was paid a withdrawal settlement upon separation, or if the participant elected (or was deemed to have elected) a deferred retirement benefit before 1 April 2007 and payment of that benefit has not yet commenced.

chunks.heading: When form PENS.C/1 should NOT be used
chunks.text: Form PENS.C/1 should not be used if the participant elected or was deemed to have elected a deferred retirement benefit on or after 1 April 2007 - form PENS.C/8 should be used instead in that case.

chunks.heading: Does submitting form PENS.C/1 commit the participant to pay?
chunks.text: No. Completing the form does not commit the participant to pay. UNJSPF or the Staff Pension Committee reviews the application and, if eligible, calculates the amount owed to add the prior service to current participation, informing the participant in writing of the amount and payment methods.

chunks.heading: How to find your Unique Identification number (UID)
chunks.text: If unknown, email requestUIDonly@unjspf.org from a work email address, including index number and/or six-digit Pension Fund number.

chunks.heading: New entrant/re-entrant note
chunks.text: New entrants or re-entrants may also validate non-contributory service under article 23 if applied for within one year of entry/re-entry (before separation if earlier), and may use any applicable transfer agreement under article 13.

chunks.heading: How to submit form PENS.C/1
chunks.text: The dated and hand-signed form must be returned to the secretary of the Staff Pension Committee or directly to UNJSPF for UN family staff members, either via MSS Document Upload (scanned JPG/JPEG/PDF) or by mail to UNJSPF's New York or Geneva offices.
